Services we offer

More than classes.

Bring us a garment that needs love or a design you want made. We teach, repair, alter and make.

Sewing Classes

Essential skills for making and fixing clothes.

Sewing Workshops

Hands-on garment creation and repair skills.

Dressmaking

Get measured and let us make you an outfit.

Hemming

Shorten or lengthen hems on pants, skirts, dresses and sleeves.

Seam Repairs

Fixing ripped or damaged seams.

Zipper Replacement

Replacing broken or faulty zippers on clothing and accessories.

Buttons

New buttons sewn on, loose ones fixed.

Taking In / Letting Out

Adjust the fit of a garment for comfort and appearance.

Patch Repairs

Mending holes and worn areas with patches.

Alterations & dressmaking

Meet your teacher

Sonia Robb

Founder & CEO, Sew Essentials: The Sewing Spot

Sonia brings more than 20 years of experience in the fashion and textile industry. Her love of sewing and teaching has helped countless students unlock their creativity and master garment making.

Under her leadership, Sew Essentials has become a community hub where sewing enthusiasts of every level learn, grow and turn design dreams into real clothes.

How it works

Getting started is simple.

  1. Choose your level.
    Browse our classes and workshops, or tell us what you want to make.
  2. Send a request or call us.
    Use the form or call 240-698-0342. We will help you find the right class.
  3. Secure your spot.
    Class fees are due in full at registration. Please read our class policy first.
